name: Blood in the Crimson Hall
summary: Blood-Queen Lana'thel stands in the Crimson Hall, still a guardian of the Lich King's dominion. Shadow's Edge receives a second power in the encounter with her: blood, drawn through the strange bond Darion's instructions set between weapon and bearer. Lana'thel is then defeated. The axe holds another of the Citadel's powers, its making tied to the one who guarded the hall.
